kind: aggregate residuals only; no reference-library output rows, code or binaries are stored

subject.call: Engine.calcTdb for bodies 10..13 (mean node, true node, mean apogee, osculating apogee)

reference.name: installed swisseph 0.5.17 (AGPL), swe_calc with ephemeris time = TDB, JPL mode on the same de441.eph; local only

reading.true_node: agrees to 0.006 arcsec in longitude and 7e-8 in distance once the Moon state is taken at the light-time retarded epoch (0.013 arcsec without it).
reading.osculating_apogee: agrees to 0.19 arcsec in longitude and 0.015 arcsec in latitude (0.34 arcsec without the retarded epoch). Its direction swings by 1.6 deg/day, so 0.19 arcsec is a 0.1 s time offset.
reading.mean_node_and_apogee: differ by about 0.2 arcsec (published Simon et al. 1994 series against the reference series); latitude of the mean apogee within 0.004 arcsec.
reading.rates: compared with centered differences of the reference positions; the osculating apogee differs by 0.05 arcsec/day because its angular rate is wild.

not_established: interpolated apogee and perigee (bodies 21 and 22): no published definition, not offered
Chiron: no independent small-body ephemeris available
bit-for-bit reproduction of the reference mean series
